title: Projective space over Z represents invertible modules with generating sections
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}=\operatorname{Proj}(\mathbf Z[T_0,\dots,T_n])$ with $\deg T_i=1$, and let $\mathcal O(1)=\widetilde{S(1)}$ be its twisting sheaf (Stacks 01MM; canonically the module glued from the $\mathcal O_{D_+(T_j)}e_j$ by $e_i=(T_i/T_j)e_j$ of [def-pc-projective-space-twist]), with the global sections $T_0,\dots,T_n$ ($T_l\mapsto T_l/1\in(S_f)_1$ on every $D_+(f)$). Pullbacks $\psi^*\mathcal O(1)$, $\psi^*T_i$ are those of [def-pc-module-pullback]. For a scheme $Y$, consider pairs $(\mathcal L,(s_0,\dots,s_n))$ of an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] and global sections $s_0,\dots,s_n\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$ that generate $\mathcal L$ (for every $y\in Y$ some $s_i$ has nonzero image in $\mathcal L_y\otimes\kappa(y)$), up to the equivalence $(\mathcal L,(s_i))\sim(\mathcal N,(t_i))$ iff there is an isomorphism $\beta:\mathcal L\to\mathcal N$ with $\beta(s_i)=t_i$ for all $i$. Then for every such pair there is a unique morphism $\psi_{(\mathcal L,(s_i))}:Y\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ with an isomorphism $\psi^*\mathcal O(1)\cong\mathcal L$ carrying $\psi^*T_i$ to $s_i$ for all $i$; equivalent pairs give the same morphism, every morphism $Y\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ arises in this way, and the construction is compatible with pullback along morphisms $Y'\to Y$. That is, $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ represents the functor $Y\mapsto\{(\mathcal L,(s_0,\dots,s_n))\}/\sim$ [def-pc-representable-functor].

proof.text: The source twist is invertible; invertible_pullback_tensor transports invertibility to tensorPullback. The standard opens cover projective space; projectiveSpace_standardCharts_part2 identifies coordinate nonvanishing with these opens. nonvanishing_tensorPullback pulls this cover back along any morphism. This proves the universal-pair clause for arbitrary universe u.

Use mem_nonvanishingLocus_iff_generatesAt to turn the assumed pointwise nonvanishing cover into the open cover generatingLocus(s_i). Each s_i is a free generator there. Reindex by ULift(Fin(n+1)) and apply the existing source exists_hom_twistRestrict over the terminal integral spectrum. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies usual pullback with tensorPullback; its unit compatibility (tensorComparison_section) transports the section-preserving isomorphism. This proves existence.

For two section-preserving usual-pullback isomorphisms, source generatingLocus_eq_preimage_standardOpen gives identical chart preimages. On each chart, map_eq_coordRatio_smul_of_twistRestrict_iso identifies the pulled-back ratio times s_i with s_j. Cancel the free generator s_i to identify all ratios. projective_pair_injective then applies the chart-ratio extensionality theorem on each open and Scheme.Opens.hom_ext_of_iSup_eq_top globally. The base maps agree because Spec(ULift Z) is terminal. This gives uniqueness without any finiteness or nonempty-scheme assumption.

For h followed by psi, invertible_pullback_tensor supplies the composition isomorphism c preserving successive pulled sections. Compose its inverse with tensorPullback(h).mapIso(e). Naturality of the adjunction unit (tensorPullback_section_naturality) and the section equations for e prove the displayed compatibility for every coordinate.
